note: Front and back are sent through different contracts (0x...7f150bd6 and 0x...6f6502b7). Each is a self-contained arbitrage that buys API3 on 0x7b1800b2 and sells it the same transaction into the API3/WETH pair 0x4dd26482, so no API3 position is carried across the victim's buy on that pair. Taken separately, the front arb nets about +0.0658 ETH before gas (+0.0507 after) and the back arb about +0.9458 ETH (+0.9339 after), but there is no single actor whose front and back legs can be netted.
